_comment: Reference for the remote-fallback lane's providers. This file is DOCUMENTATION, not loaded — providers are defined in code (bin/remote_provider_core.py) so the tier policy cannot drift. Secrets are NEVER written here: each provider reads its key from the named environment variable at call time. Copy the env var names into your shell profile to enable a provider; leave them unset and that provider's lane is disabled (the privacy default).
_how_to_check: Run `bin/remote-provider-doctor.py [provider ...]` to see which configured keys are actually alive and which models each serves right now. It is read-only and never burns quota.
_default_posture: No env var set = remote lane disabled = local-only. Set one or more keys to opt into the remote fallback. The router (bin/agent-fallback.py) picks which tiers a routing mode may touch.

gemini.notes: OpenAI-compatible. Free tier with a resetting per-day quota. The primary emergency lane and the only provider fully implemented in the MVP.

groq.notes: OpenAI-compatible, fast. Free tier resets. Declared; its dispatch path lands in a later phase.

openrouter.notes: Model-dependent cost: free models are namespaced ('openrouter/free' or ':free'). The router's free-model rule decides tier per model. Declared; later phase.

cloudflare.key_source: Cloudflare dashboard → Workers AI → API tokens
cloudflare.notes: Free monthly quota. Needs BOTH the token and the account id (the base URL has a {CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID} placeholder filled from the env). Declared; later phase.

github.key_source: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Tokens (needs models:read scope)
github.notes: Rate limits are per-token and reset. Model catalog is a separate endpoint (models.github.ai/catalog/models), not /models. Declared; later phase.

cerebras.notes: CLASSIFIED AS TRIAL, not permanently free. The router only selects it in include-trials / research-emergency modes — it is never silently used by the default emergency lane.

nvidia.notes: Free tier but the EFFECTIVE limits are dynamic (NVIDIA throttles free keys unpredictably) — treated as unknown, verified per call. Only in research-emergency. Declared; later phase.
